card.title: More Power, More Problems
card.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another customer complaint about me! I'm becoming the focus of this hotel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Now management is organizing its day around me too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll answer every complaint in writing from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My own correspondence operation, reaching into laundry. I'll need more paper.

mechanism: A treats complaints, removal and restricted work location as signs of becoming central to more of the hotel.
confusable: Unlike being pleased by trouble generally, A must specifically read each consequence as expanded influence.
comparison: D68-b incorporates management and laundry into A's reach; D68-a incorporates borrowed rooms and a trolley into jurisdiction.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
